name: Mr. Bauer
source:
"Mr. Bauer is my boss, the CEO of Daikon Industries. He tasked me with finding the leaker, and emphasized I should use any means at my disposal to do so. He's not easygoing, and he strikes me as the type of person who would do anything to protect his interests."

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dragonfirestudios/netghost/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
